rationale: interactive-dashboard-table.spec.js covers ONLY the cell-drilldown drawer-open path (search icon -> results list -> cell_* URL sync -> close cleanup). This feature is the in-place log-detail surface INSIDE that drawer: open detail (log-explorer-row-open -> log-explorer-detail-back), Insights/JSON/Table tabs, prev/next push-nav, back/Escape, copy-link, and deep-link restore via cell_event_ts. No existing spec asserts any of it, and the cell-explorer page object (dashboard-cell-explorer.js) is list-only. The Analyst's setup contract pre-designated a dedicated spec file, so a new spec is the correct home rather than cramming detail-surface tests into the drawer-open spec. NOTE: register under the Dashboards-Core shard (run-context playwright_group); the sibling interactive-dashboard-table.spec.js lives in Dashboards-Tables, so the Engineer should confirm the intended shard when adding run_files.
